name: Kids Paint
description: Paint with big brushes, a rainbow brush, stickers and bright colours, then save your drawing to the gallery.
prompt: A simple paint app for young children: a big canvas that fills the screen, thick brushes in three sizes, a big palette of bright colours, a rainbow brush, stamps of stars, hearts and animals, an eraser, undo, clear with a fun animation, and save the drawing to the phone gallery with Acornix.files.export. Huge buttons and no text needed.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: Pinta con pinceles gordos, un pincel arcoíris, pegatinas y colores vivos, y guarda tu dibujo en la galería.
